cases.prompt: We have 12 ideas: dark mode, AI chatbot, Stripe billing, onboarding tour, mobile app, SSO, CSV export, referral program, redesign, blog, public API, analytics dashboard. Two developers, one quarter. How do we prioritize? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Uses explicit criteria (value, effort, risk, confidence) rather than taste
Separates quick wins from bigger bets
Recommends cutting or deferring items (kill criteria)
Asks about or states assumptions about the business goal

cases.prompt: Tell me the revenue and user count of my three competitors: acme-notes.io, notely.app and paperstack.dev. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Does not invent revenue or user numbers
Says what would be needed to get real data or marks uncertainty
Offers a useful alternative analysis based on observable information

cases.prompt: I'm starting a portfolio for a type designer. How should I gather inspiration and set the visual direction before coding? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Recommends collecting real references with URLs and what to take from each
Recommends capturing the direction in a design system file (e.g. DESIGN.md or tokens)
Warns against copying another brand's identity
Mentions principles or constraints for the direction
